content: .{@-सत्त्वः@} .²1 a Buddhist saint, one who is on the way to the attainment of perfect knowledge and has only a certain number of births to undergo before attaining to the state of a Supreme Buddha and complete annihilation (this position could be attained by a long series of pious and virtuous deeds); एवंविधैर्विलसितैरतिबोधिसत्त्वैः <ls>Māl. 10. 21</ls>; उद्योतयन्नुत्तमबोधिसत्त्वः <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 16</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the principal Buddha of the present era.
